model_annotation: The top plot illustrates the rewards received during training for three different models, plotted against the number of training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, with tick labels indicating intervals of 10. The y-axis, labeled “Rewards,” displays a range from 0 to 0.4, with tick intervals of 0.05. A green line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” model, which displays a generally upward trend starting at approximately 0.1 and reaching a value of approximately 0.35 by the end of the x-axis. A red line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Easy” model, beginning at approximately 0.1 and rising to approximately 0.28. Finally, a blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” model, beginning at approximately 0.05 and growing to approximately 0.12 by the end of the x-axis. The bottom plot demonstrates the rewards received during training for three different models, plotted against the number of training steps. The x-axis, labeled “Steps,” uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 350, with tick labels indicating intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled “Rewards,” displays a range from 0 to 0.15, with tick intervals of 0.025. A green line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” model, which begins at approximately 0.04 and increases to approximately 0.08.  A red line represents the “Llama-LUFFY-Hard” model, initiating at approximately 0.02 and reaching approximately 0.09 at the end of the x-axis. Finally, a blue line represents the “Llama-On-Policy-Hard” model, starting at approximately 0.02 and rising to approximately 0.07 at the end of the x-axis.
